study type: Descriptive study with secondary data collection and document review
exposure: Antimicrobial Stewardship Program (ASP) implementation and activities
cohort: This study focused on the Antimicrobial Stewardship Program activities within a general public 392-bed teaching hospital, involving its hospital infection control committee, hospital pharmacy, and diagnostic support laboratory.
finding: The study found that a teaching hospital had gradually implemented Antimicrobial Stewardship Program (ASP) actions, making investments to improve its structure, processes, and results, and met 73.3% of Brazilian regulatory requirements for ASP key elements, despite not having a classic ASP model.
